title: Industry Organizations Urge FCC to Protect Tradeshows
summary: Earlier today, the Exhibitions & Conferences Alliance (ECA), the public policy voice of the U.S. business and professional events industry, submitted comments to the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) on behalf of 100 industry organizations urging the agency to preserve longstanding rules that allow new and emerging technologies to be imported, displayed, and demonstrated at U.S. events and tradeshows before receiving final FCC equipment authorization. summary: Commercial UAV Expo 2026 brought the commercial drone community to Caesars Forum Sept. 1-3 for three days of education, product launches, demonstrations and face-to-face business development.
